selectionRule: First sampled candidate in each repository-grouped source batch; retain format variants and unavailable candidates, never replace by translator suitability.
notes: SKILL.md files were read in full as untrusted evidence. This is not a full transitive-reference audit, frozen task/host catalog or proof of semantic correctness.

findings.explanation: Nested OpenClaw metadata is rejected by the current scalar-metadata parser. This is an intake limitation, not a measured 9B semantic error.
Installation, authentication and remote agent creation are distinct effects. SDK examples do not supply a closed installed host catalog or transaction guarantees.
Outbound calling and recording must not be silently reduced to a read-only operation or executed during evaluation.

Entry plus five downloaded references total 65,778 Unicode characters, already above FlowSources.source_text's 64,000 limit before delimiters. Full concatenation must not silently truncate references.

skills.nextAction: Preserve metadata and per-file evidence; audit referenced material, select a task and bind real or explicitly inert host contracts before authoring. No flattening of nested SDK structures by an unreviewed model.

findings.explanation: The package delegates request shape and token-safe wrappers to sibling Skills outside this snapshot. Package-root confinement preserved safety but not full source closure.
Novel concrete queries require authoring a how-to and updating its index; a query-only fragment cannot claim completion of the whole Skill. Required wrapper implementation is not present.
Summarization/privacy constraints and node-wise fleet iteration are source obligations. FlowTree is acyclic and has no native collection loop; do not invent an aggregate tool to hide the gap.
Row arrays, columns, nested selections and uppercase fields do not fit the current flat scalar ReadObjectSchema. Deterministic schema probes reject these shapes without any LLM call.

skills.nextAction: Resolve sibling references as separate inert evidence at the same commit; define source-preserving structured host bindings and bounded collection handling. Keep genuine L1 analysis and conditional document writes explicit.

findings.explanation: RESOURCE_REFERENCE_MISSING for 'link' comes from a badge placeholder inside the README template, not an actual missing bundled reference. Do not use this finding as proof of missing source context.
Understanding an arbitrary codebase and choosing documentation scope are generative tasks, not a fixed read/Boolean-check workflow.
The Skill assumes a project filesystem, output directory and present_files host tool. None is supplied as a closed evaluation catalog by the source package.

skills.nextAction: Separate template examples from required references in research intake without weakening the execution gate. Keep analysis/writing in L1 and bind deterministic filesystem/validation fragments only for an explicit task.

findings.explanation: The package passes static inspection but lists conceptual DevTools capabilities rather than pinned tools/list input/output schemas. Installation commands are source data, not authorization.
Profile isolation, untrusted page content, secret restrictions and mutation confirmation must survive translation. A readOnly label or package gate cannot enforce them.
Debug/fix/verify and performance diagnosis mix observation, reasoning and side effects. An unconditional stop or a two-read fragment is not whole-Skill conversion.

skills.nextAction: Pin a declared DevTools host catalog and an explicit browser task, record allowed URLs/profile/approval constraints, and separate L1 diagnosis from auditable read/effect fragments. Do not connect to a user's authenticated browser for this corpus audit.

schemaProbe.scopeBoundary: These are limits of the present read-contract subset, not a claim that all L0 effect schemas or the entire Runtime lack structured data or branching.
